sovereign_country.strategic_role: 拉美西语近岸软件研发外包与数字客服中心

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Consignment and Secondhand Luxury Goods Retail

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Colombia (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate tax distinction; registration executed through territorial Cámaras de Comercio under the RUES system)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Continental European / Neo-Romanist system; governed by the Código de Comercio, Código Civil and specialized commercial statutes; administrative tribunals coexist with ordinary civil jurisdiction)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Colombia-United States Trade Promotion Agreement - Investment Chapter (in force 2012)
Colombia-United Kingdom Bilateral Investment Treaty (in force)
Colombia-Canada Free Trade Agreement - Investment Chapter (in force)
In-force Double Taxation Agreements: Spain, France, Germany, Netherlands, United Kingdom, Canada, Mexico, Chile, Switzerland, Portugal, South Korea, India and Japan

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law 1258 of 2008 (S.A.S. regime); Código de Comercio articles 254-260 (control, group and beneficial-ownership interpretation); Law 526 of 1999 (creates the UIAF, Colombia's financial intelligence unit); Law 1121 of 2006 (AML/CFT preventive framework); Law 2010 of 2019, articles 9 and 11, and DIAN Resolution 000061 of 29 September 2020, as amended by Resolution 000164 of 2020 (annual 'Reporte de Beneficiario Final' filed through the MUISCA portal); Superintendencia de Sociedades External Circular 100-000005 of 2014, as updated by the SAGRILAFT/PTEE regime (corporate-level CDD, risk management and UBO identification duties).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Good Standing of each foreign corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction of incorporation (e.g., Companies House, U.S. Secretary of State, or equivalent commercial registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the issuing State; consular legalization at the Colombian Consulate is required only if the issuing State is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Special Power of Attorney ('Poder Especial') executed by each non-resident shareholder in favor of the local incorporator or Colombian attorney-in-fact
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the jurisdiction of signature
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (or consular legalization for non-Apostille States) plus sworn Spanish translation by a Colombian 'traductor oficial' when executed in a foreign language

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of valid passport of each ultimate beneficial owner and of each appointed statutory officer
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public of the UBO's or officer's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or consular legalization as applicable; simple notarial certification is accepted by Colombian Chambers for non-supervisory purposes

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008 (Sociedad por Acciones Simplificada), Articles 2, 4, 5, 20, 22; supplemented by Código de Comercio, Articles 110–126; and Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción del domicilio social (Registro Mercantil / Registro Único Empresarial, with tax registration before the Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN))
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument), or Escritura Pública when real property or registered assets are contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum subscribed or paid-up capital is required by Law 1258. Shareholders may fix capital at a nominal amount. Contributions may be in cash, kind, or future services. No statutory escrow account is required for share capital; foreign-exchange contributions above regulatory thresholds must be channeled through the Colombian exchange market and reported to Banco de la República.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: BOARD RESOLUTION NO. 001 CONSTITUTIVE SESSION. The duly convened initial board of directors of the Company, having reviewed the registration certificate received from the Cámara de Comercio, hereby: (1) confirms the subscription and payment of shares represented in the subscribed capital as detailed in the authenticated incorporation document; (2) adopts the registered office located at [Principal Place of Business in Colombia] as the sole legal domicile and official correspondence address; (3) appoints [Full Name] as Legal Representative and [Full Name] as Alternate Legal Representative, each with the powers defined in the bylaws; (4) instructs the Legal Representative to file the RUT with DIAN, obtain the municipal business operation license, and execute all ancillary registrations. Carried unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá / Registro Único Empresarial (RUE) online portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUE portal, select corporate registry services, and file a homonymy (name availability) request for at least two proposed names including the suffix S.A.S. Provide the proposed business scope codes ISIC 4791 and the intended domicile. Pay the official search tariff and download the name-availability certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Valid identification document (cédula or passport) of the incorporating shareholder
Proposed corporate name(s) and alternative reserve
Certificate of commercial-background search if applicable
Proof of payment of homonymy fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the requested name is identical or confusingly similar to an existing company, select an alternative or submit a formal written request for administrative review to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Signature Authentication of the Private Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notaría Pública (for public deed cases) or Cámara de Comercio (for private document signature authentication)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución according to Article 5 of Law 1258/2008, stating the shareholder identity, the precise corporate purpose of online consignment and secondhand luxury-goods retailing, the subscribed capital, the term of duration, and the governance rules. After execution by all shareholders, authenticate the signatures before a notary or before the chamber’s authorized officer. If real property is contributed, formalize by public deed before a Notary of the circuit where the property is located.
required_dossiers: Draft charter and bylaws of the S.A.S.
Certificado de homonimia
Identity documents of all shareholders
Bank receipt or valuation certificate for in-kind contributions (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the authentication officer identifies legal deficiencies, revise the document and resubmit promptly; if the notary declines due to an illegal clause, obtain a judicial correction order or prepare a corrected restated deed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Mercantile Registry Enrollment and Existence Certificate Issuance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio de la jurisdicción del domicilio social (Registro Mercantil)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the executed incorporation instrument and homonymy certificate to the Cámara de Comercio via the online platform 'Sociedad en un día' or in-person window. Provide the identification and address of directors and legal representative. Pay the registration tariff based on the declared capital and the legal-representative registration fee. The chamber will issue the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal and assign the provisional NIT (tax ID) to the company.
required_dossiers: Authenticated incorporation document
Certificado de homonimia
Copy of the identity documents of shareholders and the legal representative
Statement of capital subscription and payment
Proof of payment of the mercantile registration fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber notices defects, it grants a 5-business-day subsanación (correction) period. Submit the amended document with a cover letter identifying each correction. If the response is still adverse, request the Chamber's internal review or initiate action before the SIC.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Tax Registration (RUT) and Electronic Invoicing Activation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN – Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Once the existence certificate is obtained, register or update the company in the Registro Único Tributario using Form 5099. File the tax information: NIT, email, address, company purpose, responsible status for income tax, VAT, and industry and commerce tax. Obtain the digital certificate in the DIAN system and activate electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica) in compliance with Resolution 000165 of 2023.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal
Filled Form 5099
Copy of legal representative's ID document
Proof of current bank account and institutional e-mail
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN rejects for missing information, file a correction through the RUT portal; if the VAT declaration is inconsistent with expected e-commerce activities, request a DIAN 'calendar adjustment' or submit an explanatory letter before the Fiscal Director. For certification delays, escalate via DIAN's institutional contact.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial Registration and Land-Use/Business Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Alcaldía Municipal / Secretaría de Hacienda y Planeación
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the physical work or warehouse location, apply for the municipal Licencia de Funcionamiento and register the company in the ICA tax roll (Impuesto de Industria y Comercio). Submit the lease/title deed, the safety and floor plan, and the Certificado de Existencia. If operations are exclusively virtual and no local establishment is owned or used, only the RUE registration and ICA-roll enrollment are mandatory. For premises above 50 m² include a land-use certificate (Uso de Suelo) from Planeación Municipal.
required_dossiers: Certificado de existencia y representación legal
RUT and NIT certificate
Lease contract or property title of the operating premises
Architectural plan / floor layout showing load and occupancy
Receipt of ICA registration or its joint registration with the Chamber
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the local authority denies the land-use certificate, request a review before the Planeación Municipal reviewing committee; if the denial is maintained, file a written appeal with the municipal mayor or the SIC for unfair restriction. Correct the declared activity or relocate premises and re-apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industry-specific licensing board applies; Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) supervises commercial activities and consumer protection for e-commerce.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: N/A – municipal 'Licencia de Funcionamiento' may be applicable if holding physical inventory; no national operating permit is required for digital resale.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Corporación Autónoma Regional (CAR) / Municipal Environmental Office (Secretaría de Ambiente)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Not required for online consignment and secondhand retail; exemption classification (Categoría IV – no industrial impact).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge sources. Comply with Resolución 0631/2015 (municipal wastewater discharge limits), solid-waste management (Resolución 0470/2014 for hazardous waste), and ozone-depleting substances regulations (Resolución 1477/2009) if cooling equipment is installed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety approval from the Cuerpo de Bomberos for any warehouse or shop; structural load compliance under NSR-10 (Reglamento Colombiano de Construcción Sismorresistente) if racking is used; and registration with an Administradora de Riesgos Laborales (ARL) plus the implementation of the Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad y Salud en el Trabajo (SG-SST) under Resolución 0312/2019.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN), Colombian national tax and customs authority. Official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-services platform: MUISCA (muisca.dian.gov.co).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The S.A.S. is incorporated by private deed or public deed filed with the local Chamber of Commerce (Cámara de Comercio) through the RUES system, which simultaneously generates the NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) as the statutory tax identification number. Within one month of incorporation, the legal representative must register the company in the Registro Único Tributario (RUT) through DIAN's MUISCA platform, activating all national tax obligations: corporate income tax, VAT (régimen común), withholding at source, and electronic invoicing. Mandatory auxiliary steps: (i) obtain a DIAN-authorized digital signature certificate (firma electrónica) and (ii) activate electronic invoicing via certified software or DIAN's e-invoicing application. For the luxury resale e-commerce model, no statutory license is required; however, the RUT must reflect the ISIC 4791 activity and the company requires a registered address in Colombia plus a legal representative. Foreign non-resident shareholders may directly own 100% of the S.A.S.; no Colombian resident agent is required for the entity itself, although foreign entities without a permanent establishment engaging directly in Colombian taxable transactions must appoint a domiciled representative.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation: resident S.A.S. is a separate taxpayer liable to corporate income tax (Impuesto sobre la Renta y Complementarios) on worldwide income at the 35% statutory rate for FY2024-FY2025; no pass-through or check-the-box election is available; Colombian territorial source rules apply to non-resident shareholders, and dividends distributed to non-resident shareholders trigger an additional 10% withholding tax. Controlled-foreign-corporation (CFC) rules apply to foreign subsidiaries.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Colombia does not provide a US-style check-the-box election. Available statutory elections: (i) Régimen Simple de Tributación (SIMPLE): optional for legal entities with prior-year gross revenue equal or below 80,000 UVT (approximately COP 3,765,200,000 for 2024; UVT 2024 = COP 47,065); SIMPLE substitutes income tax, VAT, and ICA with a single gradual tax at combined rates ranging from 1.8% to 14.5% depending on sector and revenue bracket; election is made in the RUT/MUISCA and is irrevocable for two taxable years; (ii) fiscal consolidation regime for an economic group: a parent holding at least 50% of its subsidiaries may request authorization from DIAN to consolidate taxable income; (iii) export VAT exclusion under Article 481 of the Estatuto Tributario applies automatically upon substantive and documentary compliance, requiring no formal election; (iv) hybrid-mismatch regulations under Decree 2120 of 2017 are mandatory anti-avoidance provisions and no elective hybrid treatment is available.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia) and the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia. The foreign exchange regime is governed by Law 9 of 1991, Decree 1735 of 1993, Decree 1068 of 2015, and Banco de la República External Resolution No. 8 of 2000, as amended. The Ministry of Finance and Public Credit supervises fiscal aspects of exchange control.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia operates a managed floating currency (COP). Current account operations, including trade in goods and services, are freely convertible via authorized exchange intermediaries (locally registered commercial banks). Capital account operations, especially foreign direct investment into a Colombian S.A.S., require prior registration with Banco de la República and must be channeled through the official exchange market. Dividends and capital repatriations are permitted once the investment is duly registered; remittances are subject to applicable dividend withholding taxes and a 5% remittance tax for branch remittances (not for dividend distributions from a S.A.S. as a sub-national? The S.A.S. is a corporation; profit distribution to non-residents is taxed as dividend withholding). There are no non-tariff quantitative restrictions on currency conversion for legitimate commercial transactions, but all foreign exchange inflows and outflows must be reported through the 'Declaración de Cambio' filed by the local intermediary bank.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Exporters of goods must channel hard-currency proceeds through an authorized exchange intermediary within four (4) months from the date of shipment, extendable up to six (6) months for certain agricultural and mining products. For exporters of services, the term is six (6) months from the date of completion. The mandatory conversion ratio is 100%: the full amount of received foreign currency must be sold to the authorized intermediary (converted into COP) at the prevailing market rate. An exchange declaration (Formulario OPI-1) must be submitted with each settlement. Exemptions apply only for specific free-trade-zone regimes or where the value falls below the central bank de-minimis threshold; however, the presumption is full surrender and channeling for all export receipts.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility Rating: Medium for ancillary operations, Low for primary settlement rail. Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex) are not authorized by the Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia as exchange intermediaries, and cannot replace the mandatory 'canalización' of Colombian export proceeds through a local accredited bank. Using an offshore EMI to receive proceeds from the company's Colombian export e-commerce transactions would violate the foreign exchange regime and may be penalized under Law 9/1991 and Law 15/2001 (money-laundering offences). An EMI may be used as a downstream payment collector for non-Colombian foreign subsidiaries, provided all funds ultimately are repatriated in compliance with Banco de la República rules and are declared as exports of services or goods.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of at least one legal representative is generally mandatory for corporate account opening in Tier-1 Colombian banks. The local 'representante legal suplente' (resident director or appointed attorney-in-fact) must attend a face-to-face interview at the bank's headquarters. Foreign beneficial owners (UBOs) may complete a remote videoconference interview with biometric verification, but the notarized/apostilled documentation must be physically submitted. Fully remote opening is not the default; however, a few banks have made exceptions for existing clients or when the UBO has an immigration/eemptive ID card (e.g., Colombian residence visa). The local attorney-in-fact must have a valid Colombian ID and permanent power of attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident UBO and company operates in secondhand luxury goods, flagged as Medium-Risk Enhanced for potential smuggling and money laundering
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide for each UBO: passport true-copy with notarial translation, home-country tax identification, bank reference letter, and certified statement of source of wealth. The corporate dossier must include a sector-specific AML manual ('SAGRILAFT') covering supplier due diligence, product authentication, provenance and chain-of-custody documentation, item-level valuation reports by recognized appraisers, and a transaction monitoring plan with parameters for high-risk counterparties.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital injection from a non-resident shareholder without prior foreign investment registration with Banco de la República
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit the preliminary investment registration form (Formulario 160-2) and the subsequent exchange declaration (OPI-1) issued by the receiving bank, along with the incorporation certificate (Cámara de Comercio), the share subscription agreement, and a legal opinion on the origin of funds. Obtain the definitive 'Registro de Inversión Internacional' (RII) within 30 days of the wire transfer. For transfers above USD 100,000, add shareholder audited financials and a notarized wealth declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High velocity cross-border incoming wires from multiple foreign e-commerce counterparties without apparent commercial rationale, triggering enhanced due diligence (EDD)
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Maintain and share a complete, real-time ledger of all buy/sell transactions on the online resale platform, including order IDs, shipping documents, customs declarations (where required), authentication certificates, and payment receipts. Implement IP/geo-blocking for FATF-listed high-risk jurisdictions, run sanctions against OFAC/UN/EU lists, and submit to the bank a monthly 'transaction rationale' report, evidencing that each wire corresponds to a physical or digital dispatch of a covered luxury item.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant protocol: (1) Execute a capital contribution agreement under the S.A.S. bylaws; (2) Appoint a local commercial bank before the transfer; (3) File the 'Registro de Inversión Internacional' pre-registration with Banco de la República (through the bank); (4) Send the wire via SWIFT MT103 using the bank's intermediary/beneficiary reference (customs code 'CCP'?); the payment narrative must include the company's NIT (tax ID) and the investment registration number; (5) Upon receipt, the bank issues a 'Declaración de Cambio' (Form OPI-1) and credits the funds to the company's foreign-currency or COP account; (6) Finalize the foreign investment registration with the Banco de la República and update the company's share registry and commercial registry (RUE). Verification steps include bank KYC of the remitter (passport, source-of-funds declaration) and matching the EMI/remitter name to the registered foreign investor.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For payments to overseas suppliers of vintage luxury merchandise, use standard SWIFT MT103 payment orders with the purpose code 'Imports of goods' (or 'Commissions/Logistics') in the exchange declaration. The bank will require the underlying 'Declaración de Importación' if the purchase exceeds the customs de-minimis threshold; otherwise, a commercial invoice and transport document (AWB/postal receipt) suffice. For high-value settlements (>USD 20,000), prefer a Commercial Letter of Credit (L/C) subject to UCP600, issued by Bancolombia or BBVA Colombia and confirmed by the supplier's bank, to mitigate counterparty risk and provide documentary electronic evidence. All outbound transfers must be channeled through the same authorized intermediary and should align with the 'Régimen de Cambios Internacionales'.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX Forwards (delivery forwards) with an authorized local intermediary against documentary exposure
Non-deliverable Forwards (NDFs) where the underlying commercial exposure is certified and the transaction is registered with Banco de la República
Cross-currency Swaps (CCS) for long-term investment funding
OTC vanilla FX options permissible for hedging, not for speculative purposes

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil (Commercial Registry Renewal)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the registered domicile (Superintendencia de Sociedades oversight)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March, covering the calendar year registration; no renewal is effective if filed after 31 March except under the late-renewal regime.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing generates a statutory surcharge plus interest on the registration tariff; continued non-renewal for two consecutive years may result in cancellation of the merchant registration and loss of good-standing certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return – Declaración de Renta y Complementario
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually in April for the prior calendar year; exact filing date is assigned by the last two digits of the NIT in the DIAN calendar.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of 5% of the tax due for each month or fraction of delay, capped at 100% of the tax; default interest (intereses moratorios) at the current bank lending rate; false or non-filing can trigger DIAN audit and criminal tax liability.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Financial Statements and Management Report Deposit – Depósito de Estados Financieros
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the company's registered domicile
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within one month after approval by the shareholders; approval must occur within three months after fiscal year-end, therefore for a 31 December year-end the deposit is due no later than 30 April.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Untimely deposit exposes the company to administrative sanction by the Chamber and impairs the issuance of good-standing certificates; chronic non-deposit can lead to Registry cancellation of the commercial registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Final Beneficiary Annual Report – Información de Beneficiario Final
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually under the DIAN electronic filing calendar, generally between February and June, with the due date determined by the last digit of the NIT.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file or to correct inaccurate UBO information may attract monetary sanctions under DIAN’s final-beneficiary regime, and may block the issuance of clean compliance certificates.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually filed by March–June depending on NIT digit and the particular information format; DIAN publishes the exact calendar each year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late or erroneous filing is subject to the Tax Statute Article 651 penalty of up to 5% of the information value or 15,000 UVT for incomplete/incorrect data, plus possible 1,000 UVT sanction per omitted information item.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Código de Comercio Article 203 and Law 43/1990, an independent statutory auditor (revisor fiscal) is compulsory when gross assets exceed 5,000 times the current legal monthly minimum wage (SMMLV) or gross income exceeds 3,000 SMMLV at the preceding financial year-end, or when the company has more than 50 shareholders; an S.A.S. may also opt in via bylaws.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian financial reporting standards issued under Law 1314/2009 and incorporated IFRS: full IFRS, IFRS for SMEs, or Grupo 3 framework depending on size class.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: After every share-transfer event the S.A.S. must update the Shareholders' Register on or before the transfer recognition date; in the annual DIAN final-beneficiary report, the entity confirms the current natural-person beneficial-owner chain and includes all transfers executed during the reporting year. If control or ownership is acquired through an intermediate entity, the intermediate holding must be traced through to the ultimate individual and disclosed to DIAN.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members – Libro de Registro de Socios o Accionistas
Register of Directors – Libro de Registro de Representantes Legales y Junta Directiva
Minute Book – Libro de Actas de Asamblea y/o de Junta Directiva

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400–1,200 per year for registered office and professional agency services in Bogotá or Medellín
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,800–4,500 per year for a certified independent audit of an S.A.S. in the e-commerce retail resale sector

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 35% (Law 2277 of 2022; applicable from taxable year 2022 onward)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No general statutory tax holiday. Available reductions: (i) full deduction of municipal ICA tax actually paid in the taxable year (Art. 115 E.T.); (ii) optional 'Régimen Simple de Tributación' with combined rates of 1.8%–14.4% for SAS with gross income ≤ 100,000 UVT; (iii) 100% deduction of qualifying R&D investment and 130% super-deduction for certain new-hire payroll; VAT paid on fixed assets forms a recoverable credit; capital gains and occasional income taxed separately at 10%–15%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Formulario 110 (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios para Personas Jurídicas); electronically filed via DIAN MUISCA portal (www.dian.gov.co) using a registered electronic signature (firma electrónica)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Fiscal year = calendar year (31 December). Form 110 must be filed between 1 and 22 September of the following year; the exact cut-off is assigned by DIAN based on the last two digits of the taxpayer's NIT (e.g., tax year 2024 returns: 9-19 September 2025).

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Identification block (NIT, DV, legal name, tax-year, CIIU ISIC 4791 / NAICS 459510)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Basic data imported from the RUT and the SAS bylaws; verify the principal economic-activity code for online resale of pre-owned luxury goods.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders need not appear on the return; the SAS itself, represented by its legal representative with a valid Colombian RUT, files. A fiscal proxy is required if the legal representative is outside Colombia.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total sales consideration net of returns, discounts, and rebates; for consignment resale, recognize full sales value when the SAS holds title, otherwise only the commission/fee.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply Colombian source rules; export sales of goods to non-residents are generally subject to Colombian income tax only if title transfers in Colombia; keep shipping terms and Incoterms fully documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Cost of sales / Costos de venta and Deductions / Deducciones
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of acquiring vintage/luxury inventory, packaging, inspection/authentication expenses, online payment fees, logistics, and operating overhead; all expenses must be supported by invoices satisfying Art. 771-2 E.T.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to foreign suppliers for inventory and digital services must meet TP and WHT documentation; if no permanent establishment, foreign costs may still be deducted when economically related to Colombian-source income and properly documented.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Exempt and non-taxable income / Rentas exentas e ingresos no constitutivos
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Usually nil for this activity; exclude VAT collected and refunds of VAT actually passed through; do not claim unrelated exemptions without legal support.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign shareholder cannot assign exempt status on Colombian operating income through a local SAS unless a specific statutory or treaty provision applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Net taxable income and tax rates (renta líquida gravable)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Apply the 35% corporate rate after offsetting tax losses (max. 5-year carryforward for losses from FY2023 onward) and comparing with presumptive income (renta presuntiva) to satisfy the minimum tax concept.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm no investment of proceeds outside normal working capital causes a deemed-dividend or deposit-recharacterization adjustment under Art. 36-1 E.T.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Tax credits, withholdings, and payment / Descuentos, retenciones y saldo a pagar
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit source withholdings evidenced by certificates; report any advance tax and ICA credits; pay the final balance with the filing or in the DIAN-authorized instalment plan.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholdings on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders must have been remitted during the year; failure to do so triggers the assessment of a 100%-of-tax penalty plus default interest.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: 5% of tax payable for each month (or fraction) of delay, capped at 100%; if zero tax payable, minimum penalty of 10 UVT (approx. COP 497,990 in 2025). Inaccuracy/understatement: penalty of 100%~200% of the understated tax (Art. 647 E.T.) plus late-interest (Art. 635 E.T.). Failure to file the mandatory complementary returns (Form 120, Form 2276 exógena) carries separate fines from 20 to 20,000 UVT.
